description: Sharpens Clause B (the 1/2 = two Hecke channels) of the per-loop conjecture: (F1) channel count 2 is structural (quadratic Hecke relation, idempotents e+/e- exact); (F2) the 1/2 is NOT an equal channel weight (partial fractions (q^2/(q^2-1), -1/(q^2-1)), equal only at q^2=-1; (5.31,-4.31) at q0) — excluded; (F3) the 1-loop coefficient is -[2]_q x exactly, so the 1/2 is the classical-limit normalization 2x = alpha*a0. Clause B reduces to that single correspondence statement. Nothing wired.
tier: symbolic-exact (sympy; quotient-ring identities + partial fractions + series)

assertions.name: channel_count_2_structural_idempotents
assertions.detail: e+ = (sigma+q^{-1})/[2]_q, e- = (q-sigma)/[2]_q satisfy e+ + e- = 1, e+e- = 0, e+^2 = e+, e-^2 = e-, sigma = q e+ - q^{-1} e- EXACTLY mod the Hecke relation => the channel COUNT is 2 because the Hecke relation is QUADRATIC — structural, derived (not conjectural)

assertions.name: half_is_not_a_channel_weight
assertions.detail: partial fractions: w+ = q^2/(q^2-1), w- = -1/(q^2-1) (sum 1, exact); (w+,w-) = (1/2,1/2) iff q^2 = -1 (roots [-I, I], never real); at q0: (5.309, -4.309) — so deriving the 1/2 as equal channel WEIGHTS at real q is EXCLUDED (scope-(a)); the channels are counted democratically, not weighted democratically

assertions.name: half_lives_in_classical_limit_normalization
assertions.detail: tower 1-loop coefficient = -[2]_q x EXACTLY (q-dependence all in [2]_q; the measure x is q-independent, matching the working alpha[2]_q/(8pi) with x = alpha/(8pi) and NO q->1 limit); at q=1 the 1-loop total is 2x, so x = alpha/(8pi) IFF the q->1 one-loop equals the standard unit alpha/(4pi) = alpha*a0 — Clause B REDUCES to this single correspondence normalization

result.channel_count: 2 — structural (degree of the Hecke relation), DERIVED
result.half_as_weights: EXCLUDED (weights equal only at q^2=-1; (5.31,-4.31) at q0)
result.half_location: classical-limit normalization: q->1 one-loop = alpha*a0 = alpha/(4pi)
result.verdict: CLAUSE B SHARPENED TO ONE STATEMENT (scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; 1/(8pi) stays phase-4): (F1) the channel COUNT 2 is structural/derived — the Hecke relation is quadratic, giving exactly the two idempotent channels e+/e-; (F2) the 1/2 is NOT an equal channel WEIGHT — partial-fraction weights are (q^2/(q^2-1), -1/(q^2-1)), equal only at q^2 = -1, and (5.31, -4.31) at the substrate q0; (F3) the 1/2 lives in the per-loop parameter via the CLASSICAL-LIMIT NORMALIZATION: the tower's 1-loop is -[2]_q x exactly, so x = alpha/(8pi) iff the q->1 one-loop equals the universal heat-kernel unit alpha*a0 = alpha/(4pi). REMAINING CONJECTURE (all of Clause B): the correspondence normalization 'q->1 one-loop = a0*alpha'. Nothing else is open in Clause B. NO tier change.
